planets.name: HAT-P-42 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Lerna with a 4.64-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: HAT-P-42 b was found in 2012 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Lerna. Its orbit and size follow Boisse et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
